About the SATX Social Ride group ride

A big Tuesday night social ride through San Antonio. It grew from six riders to close to 300 a week, with about 30 volunteer marshals handling mechanicals and traffic. No-drop and follows the rules of the road so new riders are not stressed.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
